You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: How often must the nanoScan3 safety laser scanner be tested?

Facts:
[0] essential requirement 1.5.12 — addressesRisk — Laser radiation (laser radiation) [condition: Where laser equipment is used] [DIR, Annex I, 1.5.12]
[1] laser radiation — addressesRisk — do not damage health (do not damage health) [condition: Where laser equipment is used] [REG, Annex III, 1.5.12]
[2] optical equipment for observation or adjustment of laser equipment — requiresMeasure — no health risk is created by laser radiation (no health risk is created by laser radiation) [REG, Annex III, 1.5.12]
[3] full reassessment — hasTimeLimit — every three years (P3Y) [DIR, Annex X]
[4] laser equipment on machinery — requiresMeasure — protected in such a way that effective radiation, radiation produced by reflection or diffusion and secondary radiation do not damage health (protected in such a way that effective radiation, radiation produced by reflection or diffusion and secondary radiation do not damage health) [condition: Where laser equipment is used] [REG, Annex III, 1.5.12]
[5] tracing log of data generated in relation to an intervention and of safety software versions — retentionPeriod — five years (P5Y) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[6] laser equipment on machinery — requiresMeasure — protected in such a way that (protected in such a way that) [condition: Where laser equipment is used; radiation must not damage health] [DIR, Annex I, 1.5.12]
[7] laser equipment on machinery — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent any accidental radiation (designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent any accidental radiation) [condition: Where laser equipment is used] [REG, Annex III, 1.5.12]
[8] optical equipment for observation or adjustment of laser equipment — requiresMeasure — such that no health risk is created by laser radiation (such that no health risk is created by laser radiation) [condition: Where laser equipment is used] [DIR, Annex I, 1.5.12]
[9] recorded data on the safety related decision-making process for software based safety systems — retentionPeriod — one year (P1Y) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[10] laser equipment on machinery — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent any accidental radiation (designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent any accidental radiation) [condition: Where laser equipment is used] [DIR, Annex I, 1.5.12]
[11] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[12] internal parts and maintenance areas — requiresMeasure — appropriate lighting (appropriate lighting) [condition: Internal parts requiring frequent inspection and adjustment, and maintenance areas] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.4]
[13] warning devices — requiresMeasure — appropriate acoustic or light signal (appropriate acoustic or light signal) [condition: Where the health and safety of persons may be endangered by a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery or a related product] [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[14] internal parts requiring frequent inspection and adjustment, and maintenance areas — requiresMeasure — appropriate lighting (appropriate lighting) [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.4]
[15] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[16] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 10(3)]
[17] periodic verifications of comma 11 for equipment in annex VII — verifiedBy — Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco (Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco) [condition: relativamente alle attrezzature riportate nell'allegato VII di cui dispone a titolo di proprietà o comodato d'uso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis]
[18] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.4]
[19] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: in order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.5]
[20] periodic audits — verifiedBy — The notified body (the notified body) [DIR, Annex X]
[21] machinery design, essential requirement 1.1.4 — requiresMeasure — no dangerous stroboscopic effects (no dangerous stroboscopic effects) [condition: on moving parts due to the lighting] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.4]
[22] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[23] warning and signalling devices — requiresMeasure — the means to check that they are in good working order (the means to check that they are in good working order) [condition: where it is essential for safety] [REG, Annex III, 3.6.1]
[24] 2.3(c) machinery — requiresMeasure — automatic brake (automatic brake) [condition: if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[25] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[26] manufacturers — hasObligation — carry out sample testing (carry out sample testing of machinery or related products made available on the market) [condition: When deemed appropriate with regard to the risks presented by machinery or related products] [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[27] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: in order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.5]
[28] 1.3.7 moving parts — requiresMeasure — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.7]
[29] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[30] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: for each type of structure concerned; to verify compliance with the requirement of the second paragraph] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.3]
[31] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests (test report on static and dynamic tests) [condition: where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[32] essential requirement 1.7.1.2 (warning devices) — requiresMeasure — an appropriate acoustic or light signal (an appropriate acoustic or light signal) [condition: Where the health and safety of persons may be endangered by a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.1.2]
[33] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: for each type of structure concerned] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.4]
[34] essential requirement 1.3.6 — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed in such a way (designed and constructed in such a way that selection and adjustment of these conditions can be carried out safely and reliably) [condition: Where the machinery or related product performs operations under different conditions of use] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.6]
[35] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (ISO? no) [condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.4]
[36] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: for each type of structure concerned] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.3]
[37] software and data critical for compliance (1.1.9) — requiresMeasure — adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption (adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption) [condition: critical for compliance with the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.9]
[38] portable hand-held machinery — requiresMeasure — visual observation of the danger zone (visual observation of the danger zone) [condition: where necessary] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.1]
[39] signs on the machinery — requiresMeasure — legible at a sufficient distance (legible at a sufficient distance) [DIR, Annex I, 3.6.1]
[40] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: for each type of structure concerned] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.4]
[41] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — located outside danger zones (located outside danger zones) [REG, Annex III, 1.6.1]
[42] portable hand-held machinery, point 2.2.1(c) — addressesRisk — accidental starting or continued operation (accidental starting or continued operation) [condition: equivalent steps shall be taken if this requirement is not technically feasible] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.1]
[43] operator — hasObligation — have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times (have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times) [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[44] Static test — definedAs — the test during which the machinery or related product or lifting accessory is first inspected (the test during which the machinery or related product or lifting accessory is first inspected) [REG, Annex III, 4.1]
[45] machinery with material fed automatically to tool — requiresMeasure — the latter shall have attained its normal working condition (the tool shall have attained its normal working condition) [condition: when the work piece comes into contact with the tool] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.2]
[46] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — must be located outside danger zones (must be located outside danger zones) [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.1]
[47] Dynamic test — definedAs — the test during which the machinery or related product is operated in all its possible configurations (the test during which the machinery or related product is operated in all its possible configurations) [REG, Annex III, 4.1]
[48] Static test — definedAs — the test during which lifting machinery or a lifting accessory is first inspected (the test during which lifting machinery or a lifting accessory is first inspected) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.1]
[49] technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
